data.body: Recensus at implementation start: current HEAD is e534ee70992d6fe27a3aeea46bf30ca364bb98c6; src/rebar/_mcp_health.py is 712 lines and src/rebar/_mcp_serving.py is 207 lines in this checkout. Per the ticket's reviewed-source note, treat commit 952f0825321c755f41edce412ad1fe9f1db9268d as the attested source baseline for the extraction.
